experiences.title: XP Power logo
experiences.description: The XP Power logo in 3D. Tap "View in your space", place it on the floor, then pinch to make it bigger or smaller.

experiences.title: LBA200 Series power supply
experiences.description: 200 W enclosed AC-DC power supply, shown at its real size of 215 x 115 x 30 mm. Place it on your desk or bench to check the fit, then pinch to enlarge it and see the detail. Illustrative 3D sample.

experiences.title: Astronaut
experiences.description: A life-size astronaut. Tap "View in your space" and point your phone at the floor.

experiences.title: Waving robot
experiences.description: An animated robot that waves at you. Good for testing animation playback in AR.
